title: Cross-venue market comparison, Kalshi vs Polymarket (2026-07-24)
text: Cross-venue liquidity on Kalshi vs Polymarket: The market "Will Renan Santos win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?" is listed on both venues (Kalshi KXBRPRES-26-RSAN, Polymarket 601825). 97% of the $113k combined 24h volume is on Polymarket. It trades at 11c on Kalshi and 12c on Polymarket.
